newsitem.title: USA: Dollar grinds back above 1.79 in US, support holds.
newsitem.headline: Dollar grinds back above 1.79 in US, support holds.

text.p: *Dlr firmly above 1.79 marks, recovery from US asset selling.
*Dlr/mark bounces off solid 1.7850 support, dollar/yen off lows.
*Dow industrial average stuck down 100 pts, T-bonds off lows.
*US/Japan trade gap down 25 pct in May, overall US gap widens.
*German Chancellor Kohl downplays concern about dollar/mark.
*Market eyes Humphrey Hawkins, French budget, Buba next week.
